ipv6_enable.description: Enable IPv6 networking for Docker containers.

base.description: Base network in CIDR notation for the pool (e.g., 10.100.0.0/16).

size.description: Subnet size (prefix length) per container network (e.g., 24 for /24).

default_address_pool.description: List of default address pools for automatic network creation.

host.description: List of socket URLs, TCP addresses, or file descriptors for Docker daemon to listen on.

log_driver.description: Logging driver for containers (e.g., json-file, syslog, journald, fluentd).

log_opts.description: Key-value options for the selected log driver (e.g., {"max-size": "10m", "max-file": "3"}).

registry_mirrors.description: List of registry mirrors to use when pulling images (for improved speed/reliability).

items.description: Registry hostname or IP (optionally with port) allowed over HTTP or with untrusted TLS.

insecure_registries.description: List of registries allowed without secure TLS (for internal or development use).

storage_driver.description: Storage driver to use for container filesystems (e.g., overlay2, vfs, btrfs).

data_root.description: Root directory for Docker data (images, containers, volumes, etc.).

live_restore.description: Keep containers running when the Docker daemon is stopped or restarted.

items.description: DNS server IP address to pass to containers (e.g., 8.8.8.8).

dns.description: List of DNS servers for containers.

items.description: DNS search domain to append to unqualified hostnames in containers.

dns_search.description: List of DNS search domains for containers.

dns_opts.description: List of DNS resolver options (passed as '-o' to libc).

default_runtime.description: Name of the default container runtime (e.g., runc, crun).

args.description: Array of command-line arguments passed to the runtime.

runtimes.description: List of additional container runtimes (e.g., for gVisor, kata-containers).

exec_opt_cgroup_driver.description: Cgroup driver used by Docker (must match containerd/cRI-O if used).

max_concurrent_downloads.description: Maximum number of concurrent pull operations per image.

max_concurrent_uploads.description: Maximum number of concurrent push operations per image.

max_download_attempts.description: Maximum retry attempts for a single download layer.

name.description: Name of ulimit (e.g., nofile, nproc, memlock).

default_ulimits.description: Default ulimits applied to all containers (overrideable per container).

debug.description: Enable debug logging in the Docker daemon.

metrics_expensive.description: Enable expensive metric collection (e.g., per-container stats).

userns_mode.description: Enable user namespace remapping. Set to 'default' for subuid/subgid mapping.

labels.description: Custom metadata labels for the Docker daemon (shown in `docker info`).

disable_oom_killer.description: Disable OOM killer for containers (dangerous; may cause host instability).

plugins.description: Raw JSON for plugin configuration (advanced use only).
